steps.t: Fix the listing before you spend on it.
steps.d: Titles, bullets, images and rich content come first, because ads only pay back when the listing converts.

steps.t: Split campaigns by job and budget.
steps.d: Brand defence, discovery, Sponsored Brands and Display each get their own budget and a clear job.

steps.t: Cut search terms that cost more than margin.
steps.d: Each term is read against break-even ACOS, then kept, moved to exact match or made a negative.

steps.t: Pause ads when stock runs low.
steps.d: Spend follows stock cover, so you never pay for clicks on a product you cannot ship.

steps.t: Judge ads against total sales and margin.
steps.d: Ad sales sit next to total sales, and ACOS next to break-even, so budget follows profit.
